title: Why is counterfactual reasoning important to world models?
summary: It allows the model to simulate possible consequences before acting.
body: Counterfactual reasoning lets a system estimate the consequences of actions before taking them, including actions it may not have encountered in exactly the same form during training. It enables the question: if I do this, what will probably happen next?
